messages:
Alex W.: Heads up — putting together the SDK 9.x upgrade notes. two quick things I want to confirm before I publish: (1) auth header rename behavior and (2) streaming change for Node + Python. Can folks sanity-check?
Maria P.: Re: auth — we changed the accepted header names to prefer `x-redwood-api-key` and deprecated `Authorization` for new SDK calls. We left a fallback for one release but will log a deprecation warning.
Jin (eng): Correct. Server accepts both for now but emits a warn-log when `Authorization` is used. We should recommend env var name `REDWOOD_API_KEY` in examples.
Sam H.: Important: retries behavior also changed in 9.x — default retry removed for non-idempotent routes. Need to call this out. Previously client did automatic optimistic retries for 500s, now dev must opt-in with `retry: { strategy: 'idempotent' }` or pass `idempotencyKey`.
Alex W.: Good catch. Maria — can we add a tiny code example for Node + Python showing the new opt-in?
Maria P.: Yup. Node snippet I plan to include:```js
// Node (9.x)
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });

// explicit idempotency
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-3-small', prompt, retry: { strategy: 'idempotent' }, idempotencyKey: 'create-user-123' });
```
Jin (eng): And Python async iterator change: old blocking generator -> new async iterator for streams. Example:```py
# Python (9.x)
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])

async for chunk in client.stream_generate(model='redwood-3', prompt=prompt):
    print(chunk.text, end='')
```
Sam H.: Also note Node streaming now emits plain JSON lines rather than framed events; clients should use the new `stream_parser` util or `client.stream_generate()` helper.
devex-bot: Reminder: add a deprecation banner to the docs site and schedule a migration guide PR by EOD Friday.
Alex W.: Action items then: Maria — update quickstart and SDK CHANGELOG with header/auth examples + deprecation timeline. Jin — add server-side deprecation log & backward-compat shim for one release. Sam — write a short note about retry semantics and example opt-in. I'll draft the stream migration note and ping docs for review.
Maria P.: Will do. For the doc text I'll include a tiny troubleshooting section: common errors and how to detect 'using old auth header' vs 'missing idempotencyKey' with sample error strings.
Jin (eng): I'll create a tiny middleware that translates Authorization -> x-redwood-api-key for customers that can't rotate immediately. We should gate it behind a feature flag though.
Sam H.: Okay — also add compatibility notes for SDK integrations (Rails, Express middleware) since they often rely on `Authorization` header.
Alex W.: Perfect. One final ask: anyone seen odd corner-case with streaming + gzip responses? We had a report from a customer yesterday — probably due to double-decoding in the Node parser.
Maria P.: I saw that report — fixed in runtime branch `stream-gzip-fix`. I'll include it in the release notes: "If you previously had custom stream parsers, switch to `client.stream_generate()` to avoid double decoding."
Alex W.: Thanks all. I'll publish a draft migration doc in #devex-drafts and tag you. Please drop short PR reviews only (no long writeups). :thumbsup:
Sam H.: :eyes: will review tonight.
Jin (eng): Ping me if the shim needs config keys.
Maria P.: Sending PR in ~2h.
Alex W.: last message: adding the deprecation timeline: Authorization header will be removed in 10.0 (six weeks from roll), so compatibility shim covers that window.
Maria P.: noted. :shipit:
